## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix

- [ ] `docs` — documentation only

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes locally
- [ ] New behavior has tests (or a reason it doesn't)
- [ ] Migration generated (`npx drizzle-kit generate`) if schema changed
- [ ] No `.env` values, secrets, or AI attribution in commits
- [ ] Branch name follows `feature/<slug>`, `fix/<slug>`, `step-N/<slug>`, or `prototype/<slug>`
